text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait detains two Iraqi infiltrators, three others still at large.

- Economist says allowing non-Kuwaiti residents to trade at the stock exchange would boost national economy. Only nationals of Gulf Arab states can trade at the exchange. Kuwait plans to open trade for foreigners.
- Kuwait's imports in the first half of 1996 reach 1.2 billion dinars ($4 billion).
- Parliamentarian to propose a bill that would require employers to pay health care costs for private sector workers.
